hypothesis: Separate initial geometric matching from the fixed objective's sampling support, and use only sampling qualifications for the initial stencil; this joint change may retain more observations and permit optimization
data_role: already viewed development; sampling-domain local comparison only
initial_state: Same initial poses, node timestamps and original incoming priors as both frozen continuous predecessors
initial_geometry: Use the original reciprocal source matching and continuous center qualifier, including distance<0.08m and source-normal/gradient dot>0.8 at scale1; center normalizers are unchanged
initial_stencil: Require sampling support at nine du,dv in {-1,0,1} pixel offsets at fixed target optical Z; no geometric agreement tests at the eight displaced probes
sampling_support: Original positive optical Z and image/corner bounds, four depth values0.3..5m, depth continuity, valid corner normals and finite positive gradient norm; no filled or extrapolated depth
candidate_domain: Every retained source must keep sampling support; distance and source-normal/gradient agreement are initial matching criteria and are not repeated inside the fixed objective
meaning: A defined interpolated residual is not proof of physical visibility, correct correspondence or live tracker pose admission
population: At least200 source samples per admitted factor; selected IDs and center normalizers remain frozen throughout the attempt, without per-candidate removal
guards: Unchanged nonlinear prior and ownership, SPD condition<=1e6, full per-node0.1m/0.15rad bounds, Huber weights and eight Armijo candidates1..1/128; no damping or rank fill
convergence: Unchanged continuous full proposal strictly below1e-5m/1e-5rad per nonorigin node; original-discrete fresh system and convergence separately reconstructed
controls: Both the preceding all-qualification margin reports and the original center-only continuous reports from the same input state, independently rechecked without new fits
comparison_limits: Initial stencil and candidate-domain policy change jointly; comparisons cannot attribute an effect uniquely to one change. Source populations and objective domains differ; cost/RMS is not physical accuracy or runtime
followup_eligibility_rule: Both cases must converge all five continuous windows, improve original-discrete fresh-converged count, have no local or fresh guards, pass original0.03m RMS gates and have original-discrete median RMS no worse than margin control
scope: Local comparison only; no new full-trajectory fitting, physical scoring or tracker integration
